node.statement: Validated node 1.1.2 fixes e_env^0>0, e_cross^0>0 and K_3^0=max{1,e_cross^0/e_env^0}, so K_3^0>=e_cross^0/e_env^0. The root hypotheses give W.K3>=K_3^0 and W.e_cross<=e_cross^0, while W.K3>=K_3^0>=1 makes W.K3 positive. Multiplying epsilon<=W.e_cross/W.K3 by W.K3 gives epsilon*W.K3<=W.e_cross<=e_cross^0. Also W.K3>=e_cross^0/e_env^0 and e_env^0>0 give W.K3*e_env^0>=e_cross^0. Hence epsilon*W.K3<=W.K3*e_env^0; division by the positive W.K3 yields epsilon<=e_env^0. Together with the root hypothesis 0<=epsilon, this establishes the required smallness locally, without relying on pending node 1.2.
